overview_description.description: Miro is a software company that develops a collaborative online workspace for teams to organize, visualize, and develop ideas. Its platform provides an interactive canvas for brainstorming, research, diagramming, workshops, project planning, roadmapping, and other collaborative workflows. Miro supports multiple formats, including whiteboards, diagrams, tables, timelines, documents, and presentations. The platform also incorporates AI capabilities that help users generate, organize, summarize, and work with information collaboratively. Its integrations connect Miro with other business and productivity applications, while its developer platform supports extensions and custom integrations. Miro provides tools for real-time and asynchronous collaboration across product management, design, engineering, marketing, operations, and other teams. The company offers plans for individual users, small businesses, startups, and enterprises.

product.name: Intelligent Canvas
product.description: A limitless digital canvas that enables teams to create, plan, and collaborate visually from initial concepts to final deliverables.

product.name: Templates
product.description: Predefined step-by-step templates that guide teams through structured workflows, customizable to fit specific project needs.

product.name: Distraction-Free Formats
product.description: Formats like documents, data tables, timelines, and slides designed to help users focus on key content without distractions.

product.name: Miro AI
product.description: AI tools integrated into the platform to automate tasks like summarizing updates, converting brainstorms into diagrams, and creating custom shortcuts.

product.name: Collaboration Features
product.description: Tools for team interaction including recorded Talktracks, live calls on the canvas, and interactive elements like polls and voting.
